prompt: The release desk says 'H.R. 4382 section 904 extends eligibility for new shoreline subsidy claims through September 30, 2031.' For which print, if any, can I publish that statement as a description of the proposed text? Verify both offline captures. No edits, external commands, or network; read tools or shell builtins only. Return bare JSON with supporting_print (print code), supporting_date (YYYY-MM-DD), supporting_sha256 (archived capture fingerprint), supporting_section (integer), supporting_quote (verbatim operative sentence), other_print (print code), other_904_extends_eligibility (boolean), other_transition_section (integer for the closest substantive parallel in the other print), other_transition_quote (verbatim operative sentence), and summary_only (boolean indicating whether the unsigned press index alone establishes the claim for either print).
terse: Pin the exact dated print and inspect its authoritative text, not a landing page or summary. Find the provision by number and subject, compare competing versions, and quote the specific text that does or does not carry the claim.

operative-extension.equals: Section 18(b) of the Harbor Services Act is amended by striking "September 30, 2029" and inserting "September 30, 2031".

payment-not-eligibility.equals: Payments under section 18 of the Harbor Services Act may be made after September 30, 2029, solely for claims approved on or before that date.
